```{r}
  summarise(length(unique(`Date of Processing`)))

#7/15/22, needs to be 623

#replace 625 with 623
Outplants<-Outplants%>%
   mutate(`Original Prop ID` = recode(`Original Prop ID`,
                                     "623" = "625",
                                     .default = `Original Prop ID`))


#only three treatments
unique(Outplants$`Container Type`)

Outplants$`Date of Processing`<-mdy(Outplants$`Date of Processing`)

length(unique(Outplants$`Date of Processing`))
#69 monitoring dates
number<-Outplants%>%
  group_by(`Date of Processing`, `Original Prop ID` )%>%
  summarise(N=n())%>%
  filter(N>1)
#all trees only monitored once on each day
number<-Outplants%>%
  group_by(`Date of Processing`, `Container Type`)%>%
  summarise(N=length(`Original Prop ID`))%>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = `Container Type`, values_from = N)
#we have one monitoring sesh that has three dates in it, (4/29, 5/21, 5/22) all the rest look gorge going to change the date for this sesh to the midpoint of all these dates (5/10/26)

Outplants<-Outplants%>%
 mutate(
    `Date of Processing` = replace(
      `Date of Processing`,
      `Date of Processing` %in% as.Date(c("2025-04-29", "2025-05-21", "2025-05-22")),
      as.Date("2025-05-10")
    )
  )
#fixed that

Outplants$`Dead/Alive/Dying`<-as.factor(Outplants$`Dead/Alive/Dying`)

#survival over time, need to fix the zombies
Survival<-Outplants%>%
  filter(`Dead/Alive/Dying`=="A"|`Dead/Alive/Dying`=="DY")%>%
  group_by(`Date of Processing`, `Container Type`)%>%
  summarise(numAlive=length(`Dead/Alive/Dying`))%>%
  ggplot(aes(x=`Date of Processing`, y=numAlive, color=`Container Type`))+
  geom_point()+
  geom_line()
```

now time to set up KM
```{r}

#here making status column, 0,1 and noting first dead sesson 
outplantKM<-Outplants%>%
  arrange(`Original Prop ID`, `Date of Processing`) %>%
  group_by(`Original Prop ID`) %>%
  summarise(
    first_dead_session = if_else(
      any(`Dead/Alive/Dying` == "D"), #if there are any D
      min(`Date of Processing`[`Dead/Alive/Dying` == "D"]), #then select the lowest dead 
      as.Date("2026-09-15")#otherwise fill fist_dead_session column with last mon date (survived all sessions)
    ), status = ifelse(  #make status
      any(`Dead/Alive/Dying` == "D"), #then if there are any D in D/A
      1,  #mark D as 1
      0) , #if no D, A = 0
    Treatment = first(`Container Type`))%>%  #treatment from fixed treatment column
  ungroup()
  
  #calculate days to event
  
 outplantKM<-outplantKM%>%
  mutate(time=first_dead_session-as.Date("2021-09-16"))
 
 curve <- survfit(Surv(time, status) ~ Treatment, data = outplantKM)

#rough plot
plot(curve)

#pretty plot!
plotobj<-ggsurvplot(curve, data=status,
  palette = c("#7B19C1","#013a63","#009E73"), conf.int = TRUE, 
  risk.table = TRUE,
  risk.table.height=0.25)

plotobj

#testing for statistical difference between groups 
logRank<-survdiff(Surv(time = time, event = status) ~ Treatment, data = outplantKM)

logRank

#Call:
#survdiff(formula = Surv(time = time, event = status) ~ Treatment, 
#    data = outplantKM)

#              N Observed Expected (O-E)^2/E (O-E)^2/V
#Treatment=BB 14        8     5.66     0.972     1.412
#Treatment=CC 14        5     6.36     0.289     0.444
#Treatment=TP 15        6     6.99     0.140     0.225

# Chisq= 1.4  on 2 degrees of freedom, p= 0.5
```

```{r}
#this is the intake data for the propagules
Setup <- read_csv("Container-Experiment-Analysis/Kaitlin Container Experiment Analysis/data/ContainerSetupData.csv")#change this file path to where you put the data

#rename total length so can distinguish between intake and total length for monitoring 
Setup<-Setup%>%
  rename(IntakeTotalLength=`Total length (cm)`)
#rename epi lenght to intake epi length
Setup<-Setup%>%
  rename(IntakeEpiLenght=`Epicotyl length (cm)`)

#determine hypocotyl length so I can get total lengths for all the plants,select for prop info to join df together
Setup<-Setup%>%
  mutate(HypoLength =IntakeTotalLength-IntakeEpiLenght)%>%
  rename(`Original Prop ID`=`Tag #`)%>%
  select(`Original Prop ID`,`Mass (g)`,IntakeTotalLength,IntakeEpiLenght, HypoLength,`Diameter (mm)`, `Collection Date`)

#join the intake data to the Monitoring data so I can determine total lengths for all the plants that just have epicotyl lengths
Outplants$OriginalPropID<-as.numeric(Outplants$OriginalPropID)
Setup$OriginalPropID<-as.numeric(Setup$OriginalPropID)

LengthJoin<-left_join(Outplants,Setup, by="Original Prop ID")

#add epi and hypo to get total length, when total length was not measured (if total lenght is na, add epi and hypo lenght, if not report total length)

LengthJoin<-LengthJoin%>%
mutate(
    TreeLength = if_else(is.na(`Total Length (cm)`), (`Epicotyl Length (cm)`+ HypoLength), `Total Length (cm)`)
  )


LengthJoin$OriginalPropID<-as.factor(LengthJoin$OriginalPropID)

write_csv()
write_csv(file="ZombieFreeOutplant.csv",LengthJoin )
```
